claim: Naruto Uzumaki's birthday is October 10.
explanation: True. Official databook profile data lists Naruto's birthday as October 10.

claim: By the end of the main Naruto manga story, Naruto Uzumaki has become the Sixth Hokage.
explanation: False. Kakashi Hatake becomes the Sixth Hokage; Naruto becomes the Seventh Hokage. (Spoiler: late Naruto: Shippuden / manga ending.)

claim: The Nine-Tailed Fox was sealed inside Naruto on the night he was born.
explanation: True. The Nine-Tails attacked Konoha on the night of Naruto's birth and was sealed into him as a newborn. (Spoiler: origin of Naruto's jinchuriki status.)

claim: Naruto's father, Minato Namikaze, was the Third Hokage.
explanation: False. Minato was the Fourth Hokage. The Third Hokage was Hiruzen Sarutobi. (Spoiler: Naruto's parentage.)

claim: In Part I of Naruto, Team 7 consists of Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha and Sakura Haruno, led by Kakashi Hatake.
explanation: True. This is the original Team 7 lineup after the Academy graduation.

claim: At the start of Part I of Naruto, Sasuke Uchiha's main goal is to kill Orochimaru, who destroyed the Uchiha clan.
explanation: False. Sasuke's goal is to kill his older brother Itachi, who massacred the Uchiha clan. Orochimaru is a separate antagonist. (Spoiler: Uchiha massacre.)

claim: Kakashi Hatake's left Sharingan eye was originally a gift from his teammate Obito Uchiha.
explanation: True. Obito gave Kakashi his left eye before his apparent death. (Spoiler: Kakashi's backstory.)

claim: Sakura Haruno becomes a student of Tsunade, learning medical ninjutsu and superhuman strength.
explanation: True. Sakura becomes Tsunade's apprentice and trains in medical ninjutsu and chakra-enhanced strength.

claim: Iruka Umino was Naruto's teacher at the Ninja Academy.
explanation: True. Iruka taught Naruto at the Academy and was the first to truly acknowledge him.

claim: Rock Lee is a gifted user of ninjutsu and genjutsu in addition to taijutsu.
explanation: False. Rock Lee is unable to use ninjutsu or genjutsu and relies entirely on taijutsu.

claim: Gaara of the Sand is the jinchuriki of the One-Tailed Shukaku.
explanation: True. Gaara hosts Shukaku, the One-Tailed Beast.

claim: Jiraiya was a member of the Akatsuki.
explanation: False. Jiraiya investigated Akatsuki as an enemy and was killed by its leader Pain. (Spoiler: Jiraiya's fate.)

claim: Jiraiya, Tsunade and Orochimaru are collectively known as the Legendary Sannin.
explanation: True. The three were Hiruzen Sarutobi's students and earned the title after the Second Great Ninja War.

claim: Hinata Hyuga is a member of the Hyuga clan and possesses the Byakugan.
explanation: True. Hinata is from the Hyuga clan, whose bloodline limit is the Byakugan.

claim: Shikamaru Nara's signature clan technique is the Shadow Clone Jutsu.
explanation: False. Shikamaru's signature technique is Shadow Possession Jutsu. Shadow Clone Jutsu is Naruto's trademark technique.

claim: In Part I of Naruto, Naruto and Sasuke fight at the Valley of the End after Sasuke leaves Konoha to seek Orochimaru's power.
explanation: True. Sasuke defects at the end of Part I and Naruto confronts him in a battle at the Valley of the End. (Spoiler: end of Part I.)

claim: In Kakashi's bell test for Team 7, there are three bells for the three genin to compete for.
explanation: False. There are only two bells, designed to force the genin into a test of teamwork.

claim: Kakashi Hatake created the Chidori technique himself.
explanation: True. Kakashi developed the Chidori and later taught it to Sasuke.

claim: Naruto learned the Rasengan from Kakashi Hatake.
explanation: False. Naruto learned the Rasengan from Jiraiya in Part I. Kakashi taught Sasuke the Chidori.

claim: Naruto's parents are Minato Namikaze and Kushina Uzumaki.
explanation: True. Naruto's father is the Fourth Hokage Minato and his mother is Kushina Uzumaki. (Spoiler: revealed in Naruto: Shippuden.)

claim: Orochimaru places the Cursed Seal of Heaven on Sasuke during the Chunin Exams in the Forest of Death.
explanation: True. Orochimaru bites Sasuke's neck in the Forest of Death during the second exam.

claim: Tsunade is the granddaughter of the Second Hokage, Tobirama Senju.
explanation: False. Tsunade is the granddaughter of the First Hokage Hashirama Senju (and grandniece of Tobirama).

claim: At the end of the Chunin Exams in Part I, Shikamaru Nara is the only participant promoted to chunin.
explanation: True. Shikamaru is promoted for his strategic skill; the other participants are not promoted at that time.

claim: Might Guy is Rock Lee's sensei and Kakashi's self-proclaimed rival.
explanation: True. Guy leads Team Guy including Lee and constantly challenges Kakashi.

claim: Gaara is the eldest of the three Sand siblings, older than Temari and Kankuro.
explanation: False. Gaara is the youngest of the three; Temari is the eldest, then Kankuro, then Gaara.

claim: Iruka Umino's parents were killed during the Nine-Tails' attack on Konoha.
explanation: True. Iruka lost his parents in the Nine-Tails' attack, which makes his later acceptance of Naruto significant. (Spoiler.)

claim: Sakura Haruno comes from a famous ninja clan, like Sasuke and Hinata.
explanation: False. Sakura comes from a civilian family with no prominent clan background.

claim: Jiraiya is the author of the Icha Icha novel series that Kakashi is often seen reading.
explanation: True. Jiraiya writes the Icha Icha series, and Kakashi is a well-known reader.

claim: Orochimaru was exiled from Konoha for stealing the Forbidden Scroll of Seals.
explanation: False. Orochimaru defected after his unethical human experiments were discovered. The scroll theft was Naruto's, via Mizuki's deception.

claim: Hinata Hyuga confesses her love to Naruto during Pain's assault on Konoha.
explanation: True. Hinata confronts Pain to protect Naruto and declares her feelings. (Spoiler: Naruto: Shippuden, Pain arc.)

claim: Sasuke Uchiha first awakens his Sharingan during the fight against Haku in the Land of Waves arc.
explanation: True. Sasuke awakens the Sharingan in the fight with Haku while Naruto is in danger.

claim: Naruto learned the Shadow Clone Jutsu directly from his teacher Iruka at the Academy.
explanation: False. Naruto learned it from the Scroll of Seals he took after Mizuki tricked him; it was not part of the Academy curriculum.

claim: Kakashi Hatake becomes the Fifth Hokage of Konoha.
explanation: False. Tsunade is the Fifth Hokage. Kakashi later becomes the Sixth. (Spoiler.)

claim: Neji Hyuga is Hinata Hyuga's older brother.
explanation: False. Neji is Hinata's older cousin from the Hyuga branch family.

claim: Sasuke Uchiha kills his brother Itachi during Part I of Naruto.
explanation: False. Sasuke and Itachi fight in Naruto: Shippuden (Part II), not Part I. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kakashi Hatake's father, Sakumo, was known as Konoha's White Fang.
explanation: True. Sakumo Hatake was celebrated as the White Fang of the Leaf, a legendary shinobi. (Spoiler: Kakashi's backstory.)

claim: Kakashi's father Sakumo Hatake died in battle during the Third Great Ninja War.
explanation: False. Sakumo took his own life after being shunned by the village for abandoning a mission to save his teammates. (Spoiler: sensitive backstory.)

claim: Jiraiya's Sage Mode is learned through senjutsu training at Mount Myoboku.
explanation: True. Jiraiya trained at Mount Myoboku with the toads to gain Sage Mode, and later taught Naruto there.

claim: Jiraiya is killed by his former teammate Orochimaru.
explanation: False. Jiraiya is killed by Pain (Nagato) of the Akatsuki in Naruto: Shippuden. (Spoiler.)

claim: Might Guy opens the Eighth Gate, the Gate of Death, during the Fourth Great Ninja War.
explanation: True. Guy opens the Eighth Gate to fight Madara Uchiha. (Spoiler: Fourth Great Ninja War.)

claim: During the Chunin Exams, Rock Lee opens the Eighth Inner Gate to fight Gaara.
explanation: False. Lee opens up to the Fifth Gate against Gaara. Opening the Eighth Gate is reserved for Guy later in the series.

claim: Tsunade carries the Strength of a Hundred Seal, a diamond mark on her forehead.
explanation: True. Tsunade stores chakra in the seal over years, which she can release for powerful healing and strength.
source_name: Narutopedia - Strength of a Hundred Seal

claim: Sakura Haruno learns the Strength of a Hundred Seal during Part I of Naruto.
explanation: False. Sakura learns the seal after training under Tsunade in Naruto: Shippuden (Part II). (Spoiler.)

claim: Shikamaru Nara's official databook profile lists his IQ as over 200.
explanation: True. His databook entry states an IQ exceeding 200, reflecting his genius-level intellect.

claim: Gaara becomes the Kazekage during Part I of Naruto.
explanation: False. Gaara becomes the Fifth Kazekage in the time skip between Part I and Naruto: Shippuden (Part II). (Spoiler.)

claim: After Gaara is killed by the Akatsuki, Chiyo sacrifices her own life to revive him.
explanation: True. Chiyo uses a forbidden technique to bring Gaara back to life at the cost of her own life. (Spoiler: Naruto: Shippuden.)

claim: In Part I, Orochimaru's primary target for his next body transfer is Naruto Uzumaki.
explanation: False. His target is Sasuke Uchiha because of the Sharingan. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kakashi Hatake was a student of the Third Hokage, Hiruzen Sarutobi.
explanation: False. Kakashi was the student of Minato Namikaze, the Fourth Hokage. (Spoiler.)

claim: Asuma Sarutobi is killed by Itachi Uchiha.
explanation: False. Asuma is killed by Hidan of the Akatsuki in Naruto: Shippuden. (Spoiler.)

claim: Naruto defeats Neji Hyuga in the preliminary round of the Chunin Exams.
explanation: False. Naruto faces Kiba in the preliminaries; he defeats Neji in the first round of the finals tournament.

claim: Itachi Uchiha massacred most of the Uchiha clan but spared his younger brother Sasuke.
explanation: True. Itachi killed the clan in one night and left Sasuke alive. (Spoiler: Uchiha massacre.)

claim: Itachi Uchiha is Sasuke Uchiha's cousin.
explanation: False. Itachi is Sasuke's older brother; both are sons of Fugaku and Mikoto Uchiha.

claim: Akatsuki members wear black cloaks decorated with red clouds.
explanation: True. The black cloak with red clouds is the organization's uniform.

claim: Sasori's signature art form is explosive clay sculptures.
explanation: False. Explosive clay is Deidara's art. Sasori is a puppet master who considers puppets eternal art.

claim: Kisame Hoshigaki is Itachi Uchiha's partner in the Akatsuki.
explanation: True. Itachi and Kisame operate as a two-man team during Naruto: Shippuden's early arcs.

claim: Kakuzu's Akatsuki partner is Kisame Hoshigaki.
explanation: False. Kakuzu is partnered with Hidan; Kisame is partnered with Itachi.

claim: Madara Uchiha co-founded Konoha alongside Hashirama Senju.
explanation: True. Madara and Hashirama united their clans to found the village before their falling out. (Spoiler: Madara's history.)

claim: Zetsu is a plant-like Akatsuki member with a black and white appearance.
explanation: True. Zetsu is shown as a half-black, half-white plant-like being who spies for the Akatsuki.

claim: Zabuza Momochi is a missing-nin from Konoha.
explanation: False. Zabuza is a missing-nin from Kirigakure (the Hidden Mist Village).

claim: Kisame Hoshigaki was originally a Konoha shinobi.
explanation: False. Kisame is a former shinobi of Kirigakure and one of its Seven Ninja Swordsmen.

claim: Itachi Uchiha served in Konoha's ANBU before the Uchiha massacre.
explanation: True. Itachi was a member of ANBU and a prodigy before he left the village. (Spoiler.)

claim: Itachi Uchiha carried out the Uchiha massacre entirely alone.
explanation: False. Obito Uchiha assisted Itachi in the massacre. (Spoiler: Fourth Great Ninja War revelations.)

claim: During Naruto: Shippuden, Itachi Uchiha suffers from a terminal illness.
explanation: True. Itachi's illness weakens him and is revealed to be a factor in his final fight with Sasuke. (Spoiler.)

claim: The masked Akatsuki member Tobi is the original Madara Uchiha.
explanation: False. Tobi is revealed to be Obito Uchiha, who took Madara's name. (Spoiler: Fourth Great Ninja War.)

claim: Obito Uchiha was believed to have died at Kannabi Bridge during the Third Great Ninja War.
explanation: True. Konoha believed Obito was crushed by a boulder at Kannabi Bridge. (Spoiler.)

claim: Obito Uchiha was Kakashi Hatake's student.
explanation: False. Obito was Kakashi's teammate on Minato Namikaze's team. (Spoiler.)

claim: Madara Uchiha and Hashirama Senju fought each other at the Valley of the End.
explanation: True. Their battle at the Valley of the End shaped the landscape and ended with Hashirama's victory. (Spoiler.)

claim: Madara Uchiha's younger brother was named Izuna.
explanation: True. Izuna Uchiha was Madara's younger brother and died in the Senju-Uchiha conflict. (Spoiler.)

claim: Madara Uchiha obtained his Eternal Mangekyo Sharingan by transplanting his brother Izuna's eyes.
explanation: True. After Izuna's death, Madara received his brother's eyes and gained the Eternal Mangekyo. (Spoiler.)

claim: Nagato, the man behind Pain, was a member of the Uchiha clan.
explanation: False. Nagato is of Uzumaki descent and a native of Amegakure. (Spoiler.)

claim: Nagato, Yahiko and Konan were orphans of Amegakure who were trained by Jiraiya.
explanation: True. Jiraiya took the three orphans as students during the Second Great Ninja War era. (Spoiler.)

claim: Konan controls the Six Paths of Pain through chakra receivers.
explanation: False. Nagato controls the Six Paths of Pain with his Rinnegan. Konan is Nagato's partner. (Spoiler.)

claim: Konan's signature ninja art is based on paper.
explanation: True. Konan manipulates paper in her origami-based techniques.

claim: Kisame Hoshigaki wields the sword Kubikiribocho.
explanation: False. Kisame wields Samehada; Kubikiribocho belonged to Zabuza.

claim: Kisame Hoshigaki's sword Samehada can absorb chakra.
explanation: True. Samehada devours chakra from opponents and its jutsu.

claim: Deidara was originally a missing-nin from Kumogakure.
explanation: False. Deidara was a missing-nin from Iwagakure (the Hidden Stone Village).

claim: Deidara dies by detonating himself in a final attack during his fight with Sasuke.
explanation: True. Deidara triggers his C0 self-destruct technique against Sasuke. (Spoiler: Naruto: Shippuden.)

claim: Sasori is killed by Sakura Haruno and Chiyo.
explanation: True. Sakura and Chiyo defeat Sasori together. (Spoiler: Naruto: Shippuden.)

claim: Kakuzu is originally a shinobi from Kirigakure.
explanation: False. Kakuzu is from Takigakure (the Hidden Waterfall Village).

claim: Hidan's Jashin ritual lets him share wounds with a victim whose blood he has tasted.
explanation: True. Hidan's ritual links him to his victim so that damage to him is inflicted on the victim.

claim: Zetsu was created by Orochimaru.
explanation: False. Zetsu is tied to Obito, Madara and Kaguya's will, not Orochimaru. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kabuto Yakushi grew up as an orphan under the care of Nonou Yakushi.
explanation: True. Nonou took in the orphaned Kabuto and raised him. (Spoiler: Kabuto's backstory.)

claim: Danzo Shimura commanded Konoha's Uchiha-run Military Police Force.
explanation: False. The Uchiha clan ran the Military Police Force. Danzo led the covert organization known as Root. (Spoiler.)

claim: Danzo Shimura had multiple Sharingan implanted in his right arm.
explanation: True. Danzo's arm held many Sharingan used for Izanagi. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Uchiha clan founded the Akatsuki organization.
explanation: False. Akatsuki was founded by Yahiko, Nagato and Konan, and later controlled by Obito. (Spoiler.)

claim: Itachi Uchiha's Mangekyo Sharingan abilities include Amaterasu, Tsukuyomi and Susanoo.
explanation: True. These are his three signature Mangekyo techniques.

claim: Itachi Uchiha is killed by Obito Uchiha.
explanation: False. Itachi dies after his battle with Sasuke, weakened by illness. (Spoiler.)

claim: Obito Uchiha's body was partly rebuilt using Hashirama Senju's cells.
explanation: True. After the Kannabi Bridge incident, his injuries were treated with Hashirama's cells. (Spoiler.)

claim: Obito Uchiha was the original founder of the Akatsuki.
explanation: False. Yahiko, Nagato and Konan founded Akatsuki. Obito later took control of it. (Spoiler.)

claim: Madara Uchiha is revived with Edo Tensei during the Fourth Great Ninja War.
explanation: True. Kabuto revives Madara among other shinobi using Edo Tensei. (Spoiler.)

claim: Pain invades Konoha in order to capture Gaara.
explanation: False. Pain attacks Konoha to capture Naruto and the Nine-Tails. Gaara's Akatsuki capture happens earlier. (Spoiler.)

claim: Nagato can summon the Gedo Mazo statue using his Rinnegan.
explanation: True. Nagato summons the Gedo Mazo statue in Naruto: Shippuden. (Spoiler.)

claim: Konan is killed in battle by Orochimaru.
explanation: False. Konan dies fighting Obito, who was posing as Madara. (Spoiler.)

claim: Deidara's original Akatsuki partner was Hidan.
explanation: False. Deidara was partnered with Sasori. Hidan's partner is Kakuzu.

claim: Hiruko is Sasori's true body.
explanation: False. Hiruko is a puppet shell Sasori uses to hide his true body, which is a puppet modeled on his younger self.

claim: Hidan is defeated by Shikamaru Nara.
explanation: True. Shikamaru traps Hidan and buries him. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kakuzu is killed by his partner Hidan.
explanation: False. Kakuzu is defeated by Naruto and Kakashi. (Spoiler.)

claim: White Zetsu clones are derived from Hashirama Senju's cells.
explanation: True. The White Zetsu army is created using Hashirama's cells. (Spoiler.)

claim: Orochimaru was killed by Itachi Uchiha.
explanation: False. Itachi sealed Orochimaru's arms but did not kill him. (Spoiler.)

claim: Danzo Shimura was killed by Kakashi Hatake.
explanation: False. Danzo dies fighting Sasuke Uchiha. (Spoiler.)

claim: When a Shadow Clone is dispelled, its experiences return to the original user.
explanation: True. Shadow Clones transfer their memories and experiences to the user when dispelled.

claim: Shadow Clones are intangible illusions that cannot physically touch anything.
explanation: False. Shadow Clones are solid, physical copies that can fight and interact with objects. Illusory copies are a different technique.

claim: The Sharingan allows its user to copy many ninjutsu, taijutsu and genjutsu techniques they witness.
explanation: True. Copying is one of the Sharingan's core abilities, though it has limits.

claim: The Byakugan is a bloodline ability of the Uchiha clan.
explanation: False. The Byakugan belongs to the Hyuga clan. The Sharingan is the Uchiha ability.

claim: Wood Release is the signature ability of the First Hokage, Hashirama Senju.
explanation: True. Hashirama was famed for Wood Release, an ability he had from birth.

claim: The Rasengan is a Lightning Release technique.
explanation: False. The basic Rasengan is pure chakra shaping with no nature transformation. Variants add natures such as wind.

claim: Gaara's signature ability is controlling sand.
explanation: True. Gaara manipulates sand as both a weapon and a defense.

claim: Amaterasu is a Water Release technique.
explanation: False. Amaterasu is a Mangekyo Sharingan technique that produces inextinguishable black flames.

claim: A jinchuriki is a person who hosts a tailed beast sealed inside them.
explanation: True. The term refers to the human host of a tailed beast.

claim: There are only seven tailed beasts, numbered from one to seven tails.
explanation: False. There are nine named tailed beasts, from the One-Tail to the Nine-Tails, plus the Ten-Tails. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Rasenshuriken is a Rasengan variant that incorporates wind chakra.
explanation: True. Naruto adds Wind Release to the Rasengan to create the Rasenshuriken.

claim: When Naruto first used the Rasenshuriken, it damaged his own arm's chakra network.
explanation: True. The technique initially harmed Naruto's own body until he gained the ability to use it more safely. (Spoiler: Naruto: Shippuden.)

claim: The Chidori is a Wind Release technique.
explanation: False. The Chidori is a Lightning Release technique.

claim: In the basic chakra nature cycle, Lightning Release has an advantage over Earth Release.
explanation: True. Lightning is strong against Earth, while Wind is strong against Lightning.

claim: In the basic chakra nature cycle, Fire Release is strong against Water Release.
explanation: False. Water is strong against Fire. Fire is strong against Wind.

claim: Naruto's Kurama Chakra Mode is achieved through cooperation with Kurama.
explanation: True. Naruto and Kurama reach mutual understanding and can share chakra. (Spoiler: Fourth Great Ninja War arc.)

claim: Naruto learns Sage Mode from Tsunade.
explanation: False. Naruto learns Sage Mode on Mount Myoboku under the toads, notably Fukasaku. Tsunade teaches medical ninjutsu.

claim: The Rinnegan is a dojutsu associated with the Sage of Six Paths.
explanation: True. The Rinnegan is tied to the Sage of Six Paths. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Mangekyo Sharingan can be awakened through normal training alone.
explanation: False. In the series, the Mangekyo Sharingan is awakened through an intense emotional trauma, typically the loss of a loved one.

claim: Prolonged use of the Mangekyo Sharingan can cause a user's eyesight to deteriorate.
explanation: True. The Mangekyo strains the eyes and can lead to blindness.

claim: The Byakugan's wide field of vision has a blind spot.
explanation: True. Despite its near-360-degree vision, the Byakugan has a small blind spot.

claim: The Byakugan can copy the techniques of an opponent in the same way the Sharingan can.
explanation: False. The Byakugan gives wide vision and the ability to see chakra, but it does not copy techniques.

claim: The Mystical Palm Technique is a form of medical ninjutsu.
explanation: True. It is a basic healing technique used by medical ninja.

claim: Kushina Uzumaki used the Reaper Death Seal when sealing the Nine-Tails into Naruto.
explanation: False. Minato Namikaze used the Reaper Death Seal; Kushina's Adamantine Sealing Chains restrained the Nine-Tails. (Spoiler.)

claim: A shinobi needs a signed contract, sealed with blood, to use a summoning technique with a particular animal.
explanation: True. A contract signed in blood is required for the animal summoning techniques.

claim: Naruto's summoning contract is with the snakes.
explanation: False. Naruto's contract is with the toads of Mount Myoboku. The snakes are tied to Orochimaru.

claim: Gamabunta is a giant toad that Naruto summons.
explanation: True. Gamabunta is a large toad summoned by Naruto, as well as by Jiraiya and Minato.

claim: The five basic chakra natures are Fire, Wind, Lightning, Earth and Water.
explanation: True. These five are the basic nature transformations.

claim: Wood Release is one of the five basic chakra natures.
explanation: False. Wood Release is an advanced nature, not one of the five basic natures.

claim: Wood Release is a combination of Earth Release and Water Release.
explanation: True. It blends Earth and Water natures.

claim: Ice Release is one of the five basic chakra natures.
explanation: False. Ice Release is an advanced nature that combines Water and Wind.

claim: Haku's Ice Release combines Water Release and Wind Release.
explanation: True. Haku's bloodline lets him combine these two natures into ice.

claim: The Hyuga Gentle Fist works by damaging only a target's external muscles.
explanation: False. The Gentle Fist strikes the opponent's chakra network and internal organs.

claim: The Sharingan can copy any kekkei genkai the user sees.
explanation: False. The Sharingan copies techniques, but bloodline abilities cannot be copied this way.

claim: The Rasengan was invented by Jiraiya.
explanation: False. Minato Namikaze invented the Rasengan; Jiraiya taught it to Naruto. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kakashi Hatake's Kamui is a space-time technique tied to his Mangekyo Sharingan.
explanation: True. Kakashi acquired the Mangekyo Sharingan and the Kamui ability. (Spoiler.)

claim: Susanoo can only be used by Itachi Uchiha.
explanation: False. Susanoo is a Mangekyo ability used by several Uchiha, including Sasuke. (Spoiler.)

claim: Matatabi is the Two-Tailed tailed beast.
explanation: True. Matatabi is the Two-Tails, a cat-like beast.

claim: Gyuki is the Seven-Tailed beast.
explanation: False. Gyuki is the Eight-Tails; the Seven-Tails is Chomei.

claim: Killer B is the jinchuriki of the Eight-Tailed beast.
explanation: True. Killer B hosts Gyuki, the Eight-Tails.

claim: Yagura, the Fourth Mizukage, was the jinchuriki of the Eight-Tails.
explanation: False. Yagura hosted the Three-Tails. (Spoiler.)

claim: Fu is the jinchuriki of the Seven-Tails.
explanation: True. Fu from Takigakure hosts the Seven-Tails.

claim: Han is the jinchuriki of the Four-Tails.
explanation: False. Han hosts the Five-Tails. The Four-Tails is hosted by Roshi.

claim: Naruto and Sasuke receive powers from the Sage of Six Paths in the Fourth Great Ninja War arc.
explanation: True. The Sage of Six Paths grants each of them power. (Spoiler.)

claim: Hashirama Senju could suppress tailed beasts using Wood Release.
explanation: True. Hashirama's Wood Release allowed him to subdue tailed beasts. (Spoiler.)

claim: Madara Uchiha used his Sharingan to control the Nine-Tails during his fight with Hashirama Senju.
explanation: True. Madara controlled Kurama with his Sharingan at the Valley of the End. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kaguya Otsutsuki is the Sage of Six Paths.
explanation: False. The Sage of Six Paths is Hagoromo Otsutsuki, Kaguya's son. (Spoiler.)

claim: Sasuke obtained his Rinnegan from Nagato.
explanation: False. Sasuke's Rinnegan awakened through the influence of the Sage of Six Paths. (Spoiler.)

claim: Izanagi can be used repeatedly with no penalty to the user.
explanation: False. Izanagi costs the user the use of the eye used for it. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Dead Demon Consuming Seal can be used with no cost to the user's life.
explanation: False. The seal costs the user their life. (Spoiler.)

claim: In Part I of Naruto, the second part of the Chunin Exams takes place in the Forest of Death.
explanation: True. The second exam is a survival test held in Training Ground 44, nicknamed the Forest of Death.

claim: Amegakure, the Hidden Rain Village, is one of the Five Great Shinobi Villages.
explanation: False. The Five Great Shinobi Villages are Konoha, Suna, Kiri, Kumo and Iwa. Ame is a smaller village.

claim: The leaders of the Five Great Shinobi Villages are called Kage, such as the Hokage and Kazekage.
explanation: True. Each great village is led by a Kage: Hokage, Kazekage, Mizukage, Raikage and Tsuchikage.

claim: The leader of Sunagakure is called the Hokage.
explanation: False. The leader of Sunagakure is the Kazekage. Hokage is the title of Konoha's leader.

claim: Naruto and Jiraiya travel to find Tsunade so that she can become Konoha's Fifth Hokage.
explanation: True. Jiraiya and Naruto search for Tsunade to bring her back as Hokage after the Third Hokage's death. (Spoiler.)

claim: In Part I, Sasuke leaves Konoha to join the Akatsuki.
explanation: False. Sasuke leaves to join Orochimaru in the Sound Village to gain power. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Fourth Great Ninja War is fought by the Allied Shinobi Forces against an army led by Madara and Obito.
explanation: True. The five nations unite as the Allied Shinobi Forces to oppose the Akatsuki's war effort. (Spoiler.)

claim: Hiruzen Sarutobi was the First Hokage of Konoha.
explanation: False. The First Hokage was Hashirama Senju. Hiruzen was the Third Hokage.

claim: Naruto's mother, Kushina, belonged to the Uzumaki clan of Uzushiogakure.
explanation: True. Kushina was an Uzumaki from Uzushiogakure, the Hidden Whirlpool Village. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Uzumaki clan originally came from Kirigakure.
explanation: False. The Uzumaki clan was based in Uzushiogakure in the Land of Whirlpools.

claim: The Five Kage Summit is called to address the threat posed by the Akatsuki and by Sasuke Uchiha's actions.
explanation: True. The Kage meet to discuss how to deal with Akatsuki and Sasuke. (Spoiler: Naruto: Shippuden.)

claim: The Five Kage Summit was held in Kumogakure.
explanation: False. The summit takes place in the Land of Iron.

claim: The Allied Shinobi Forces are formed from multiple shinobi nations to fight in the Fourth Great Ninja War.
explanation: True. The alliance joins the shinobi nations together under one banner. (Spoiler.)

claim: Minato Namikaze earned the nickname Yellow Flash during the Third Great Ninja War.
explanation: True. Minato became famed for his speed in the war, notably against Iwagakure. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kakashi Hatake is the original Yellow Flash of Konoha.
explanation: False. The Yellow Flash title belongs to Minato. Kakashi is known as Copy Ninja Kakashi.

claim: The Uzumaki clan was known for its sealing techniques and strong life force.
explanation: True. Uzumaki members were renowned sealing masters with unusual vitality.

claim: The Senju and Uchiha clans were allies before the founding of Konoha.
explanation: False. The two clans were bitter rivals before they united to found the village. (Spoiler.)

claim: In the Hyuga clan, the Caged Bird Seal is placed on members of the Branch family.
explanation: True. The seal marks Branch family members and lets the Main family control them.

claim: The Caged Bird Seal is placed on members of the Hyuga Main family.
explanation: False. The Main family does not bear the seal; it is applied to the Branch family.

claim: In Naruto: Shippuden, Sasuke forms a team called Hebi, later known as Taka.
explanation: True. Sasuke assembles his own team after leaving Orochimaru. (Spoiler.)

claim: The invasion of Konoha during the Chunin Exams finals is orchestrated by Orochimaru together with Sunagakure.
explanation: True. Orochimaru's Sound Village and Suna launch the attack on Konoha. (Spoiler.)

claim: Hiruzen Sarutobi dies during the invasion of Konoha.
explanation: True. The Third Hokage dies fighting Orochimaru. (Spoiler.)

claim: Hiruzen Sarutobi is killed by Sasori during the invasion of Konoha.
explanation: False. Sasori is an Akatsuki member who has no role in the invasion. Hiruzen's fight is with Orochimaru. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Akatsuki seeks to capture the tailed beasts.
explanation: True. The organization hunts the jinchuriki to extract the tailed beasts. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Akatsuki seeks the tailed beasts so that its leader can become Hokage.
explanation: False. The tailed beasts are collected for the organization's plans, not to install a Hokage. (Spoiler.)

claim: Obito's main plan in the Fourth Great Ninja War is the Infinite Tsukuyomi.
explanation: True. Obito's goal is to trap the world in a genjutsu. (Spoiler.)

claim: Chakra was first created by the Sage of Six Paths.
explanation: False. In the series' account, chakra originates from the fruit of the God Tree, consumed by Kaguya. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kaguya Otsutsuki created the nine tailed beasts.
explanation: False. The Sage of Six Paths created the tailed beasts by splitting the Ten-Tails. (Spoiler.)

claim: Naruto's mother, Kushina, was the jinchuriki of the Eight-Tails.
explanation: False. Kushina was the Nine-Tails' jinchuriki before Naruto. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kakashi Hatake is the Hokage during the Fourth Great Ninja War.
explanation: False. Tsunade is the Hokage during the war; Kakashi becomes Hokage afterward. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Sage of Six Paths created the nine tailed beasts by dividing the Ten-Tails' chakra.
explanation: True. The Sage split the Ten-Tails' chakra into nine beasts. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Uchiha clan descends from Hamura Otsutsuki.
explanation: False. The Uchiha descend from Indra, while Hamura's line leads to the Hyuga. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Hyuga clan descends from Hamura Otsutsuki, the younger brother of the Sage of Six Paths.
explanation: True. The Hyuga clan is descended from Hamura. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Uchiha clan descends from Indra Otsutsuki, and the Senju clan from Asura Otsutsuki.
explanation: True. The two clans trace their lineage to the Sage's two sons. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Senju clan descends from Indra Otsutsuki.
explanation: False. The Senju descend from Asura. Indra's line leads to the Uchiha. (Spoiler.)

claim: The samurai of the Land of Iron are led by Mifune.
explanation: True. Mifune is the general of the Land of Iron's samurai. (Spoiler.)

claim: Mifune is the leader of Konoha's ANBU.
explanation: False. Mifune leads the samurai of the Land of Iron, not Konoha's ANBU. (Spoiler.)

claim: Uzushiogakure, the village of the Uzumaki clan, was destroyed.
explanation: True. Uzushiogakure was destroyed, scattering the Uzumaki clan. (Spoiler.)

claim: Hashirama Senju's wife, Mito Uzumaki, was a jinchuriki of the Nine-Tails.
explanation: True. Mito served as the Nine-Tails' jinchuriki before Kushina. (Spoiler.)

claim: Tobirama Senju created the Edo Tensei technique.
explanation: True. Tobirama, the Second Hokage, created the Edo Tensei. (Spoiler.)

claim: Hiruzen Sarutobi trained under Tobirama Senju.
explanation: True. Hiruzen was a student of the Second Hokage. (Spoiler.)

claim: Naruto and Sasuke are described in the story as inheriting the chakra of Asura and Indra.
explanation: True. The Sage of Six Paths says their chakra is inherited from his sons. (Spoiler.)

claim: Naruto and Sasuke's final battle takes place at the Valley of the End.
explanation: True. Their last fight takes place at the Valley of the End after the war. (Spoiler.)

claim: Tsunade became Hokage before Orochimaru's invasion of Konoha.
explanation: False. The Third Hokage was still Hokage during the invasion. Tsunade became Fifth Hokage afterward. (Spoiler.)

claim: Naruto and Jiraiya find Tsunade inside Konoha.
explanation: False. They find Tsunade outside Konoha, in Tanzaku Town. (Spoiler.)

claim: The invasion of Konoha is led by Pain.
explanation: False. The invasion in Part I is led by Orochimaru. Pain attacks Konoha later in Naruto: Shippuden. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Allied Shinobi Forces consist only of shinobi from Konoha and Suna.
explanation: False. The alliance draws on the five great nations and the samurai of the Land of Iron. (Spoiler.)

claim: Tsunade serves as the supreme commander of the Allied Shinobi Forces.
explanation: False. Mifune is the supreme commander of the alliance. (Spoiler.)

claim: Kaguya Otsutsuki is sealed by Sasuke alone.
explanation: False. Kaguya is sealed by Team 7 working together, with Naruto and Sasuke at the center. (Spoiler.)

claim: The Sage of Six Paths had three sons.
explanation: False. The Sage of Six Paths had two sons, Indra and Asura. (Spoiler.)
